library.title: Make a protected disclosure to the anti-corruption commission
library.intro: Report wrongdoing in a public body in confidence. Who you are is kept apart from your report and read only by the official handling it or one specifically authorised; it is never in a list, a search or an export. A report is not proof: the commission assesses it.
library.filled_by: Anyone, including a public official: through the commission's confidential channel, at an office or on paper.
library.authority: The anti-corruption commission the nation names for the anticorruption slot of the deployment profile (authorityFor('anticorruption'), shipped empty); independent once named (INDEPENDENT_SLOTS). Never a ministry by name.

nation_values.decision: The days within which the body acknowledges what it received.

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
The body is the institution the nation names for its slot of the deployment profile (ombudsman, humanRights, anticorruption, supremeAudit, dataProtection), shipped empty; it is independent once named
deviations.why: Authority comes from the deployment profile, never a ministry by name; no oversight body ships for a nation.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(); lib/nation/deployment.ts INDEPENDENT_SLOTS (plan I8)

deviations.what: A finding is a recommendation with reasons, never an order or an automatic decision; whatever it asks is done, or not, by the institution concerned under its own procedures
deviations.why: Part 12 §7.3: a recommendation is not automatically a binding order; AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: lib/oversight/register.ts; CLAUDE.md Government operating model (AI never makes a legally material decision)

deviations.what: The answers about the person who raised the matter (whether anonymous, name, contact, consent to share, protection needs) go to the protected-identity record, never into the case: no list, search, case read or export carries them
deviations.why: Part 4 §C.7: separate source identity from the general case record; Part 12 §10.2: protect whistleblower and complainant identities.
deviations.rule: lib/oversight/protected-identity.ts and lib/oversight/intake.ts receiveProtected() (acceptance P4-06, P4-07)

deviations.what: A referral to a prosecution, a court or another body carries the case reference and the reason only; nothing of the file passes and no case is opened there
deviations.why: Prosecution referrals that identify a person need a country's legal review (owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1; plan I11).

deviations.what: No field names a person as a suspect or records a finding of guilt: what is alleged is restricted free text, assessed by the commission's officials
deviations.why: A report is not proof; suspect-identifying records need legal review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Police (no field records a suspect); lib/forms/scope.ts LEGAL_REVIEW_FIELD_WORDS

deviations.what: No score, rating or automated assessment: admissibility, findings and referrals are decided by the body's officials with reasons
deviations.why: AI may help a human review but never labels a person or issues a finding.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: AI never makes a legally material decision

deviations.what: Whether anonymous submissions are accepted is the nation's decision (configured_profile, binding until set)
deviations.why: Part 12 §2.5: anonymous or pseudonymous submissions where appropriate and lawful.

deviations.what: Declarations of interest and their verification are not this form: a declared interest recuses an official at once (lib/transitions); a declarations register is a later row of plan I8
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Transitions: a declared interest recuses at once (CaseFacts.recused)

quotes: Protected disclosure to an independent body
Independent investigation and enforcement within statutory powers
Corruption prevention, authorised investigations, disclosures and referrals.
Separates allegations, intelligence, verified evidence, findings and referrals; protects sources and restricts sensitive access.
Records: disclosure, source protection classification, allegation, evidence, investigation, declaration, verification event, finding, referral and authorised outcome.
Receive the report through an approved confidential channel.

platform.how: receiveProtected(): the commission's own officials take it; the identity goes to the protected record at once

quotes: Separate source identity from the general case record where practicable.
Assess jurisdiction and immediate protection needs.
Restrict access to specifically authorised staff.

platform.how: The assigned official, or one an official who can sign there authorises; every read logged

quotes: Preserve evidence and record the chain of custody.
Conduct the authorised review or investigation.
Record the outcome, referral or closure and reasons.
Monitor authorised protection measures without exposing the source to unrelated users.

platform.how: Protection needs are part of the protected record; markers show only the role and whether the person is anonymous

quotes: Safeguards: a flagged procurement transaction is not proof of corruption; an undisclosed interest is not automatically proof of criminal conduct.
AI may identify patterns for human review, but it must not label a person corrupt, issue a legally material finding or automatically refer a person for punitive action without the prescribed process.

platform.how: No score; admission, findings and referrals by officials with reasons, under the commission's procedure
